title: The Cham King Who Sacked Thăng Long in 1371 #shorts
description:
In 1371, a Cham army sacked Thăng Long. The Vietnamese called its king Chế Bồng Nga. His real Cham name is not known.

Full story (9 min): https://youtu.be/nuktXZNH_fQ

Sources: Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư; J. Whitmore (2011). Illustrations and narration are AI-assisted. Corrections welcome in the comments.
